anchorAudit.rationale: Re-audited all final bright-v4 pixels at thumbnail, 100% and 200% scales; every retained anchor targets a distinct visible object or part. The expanded set names readable architectural, transit, crossing and vehicle parts inside the same disjoint destination crops. The ambiguous edge-cropped bus door and the road duplicate of street remain removed, and the unmarked yellow vehicle stays conservatively labelled car. The professional vocabulary pass adds 60 additional region-grounded nouns across the reviewed facilities, equipment, diagnostic, disease, medicine or building-system crops.
